mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members actor ON actor.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND ( n.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE t.task_id = n.task_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id ) ) AND ( (n.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(n.status, 1) <> 0) OR actor.role >= 80 ) )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members actor ON actor.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND actor.member_id = #{requester_member_id} AND actor.status = 0 AND ( ( n.notice_type = '0' AND n.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND actor.role >= 70 ) OR ( n.notice_type = '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL AND ( actor.role >= 70 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.status = 0 AND own.role >= 50 ) ) ) ) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_type, n.workspace_id, n.project_id, n.task_id, n.member_id, n.title, n.status, NVL(n.view_count, 0) AS view_count, TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, md.name AS member_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_files nf WHERE nf.notice_id = n.notice_id) AS file_count FROM notice n LEFT JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = n.member_id
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_type, n.workspace_id, n.project_id, n.task_id, n.member_id, n.title, n.content, TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, TO_CHAR(n.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated, n.status, NVL(n.view_count, 0) AS view_count, md.name AS member_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_files nf WHERE nf.notice_id = n.notice_id) AS file_count FROM notice n LEFT JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = n.member_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL

SELECT nf.notice_id AS "noticeId", nf.notice_file_id AS "noticeFileId", nf.original_name AS "originalName", nf.stored_name AS "storedName", nf.file_path AS "filePath", nf.file_size AS "fileSize" FROM notice_files nf JOIN notice n ON n.notice_id = nf.notice_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL
ORDER BY nf.notice_file_id

SELECT nf.notice_id AS "noticeId", nf.notice_file_id AS "noticeFileId", nf.original_name AS "originalName", nf.stored_name AS "storedName", nf.file_path AS "filePath", nf.file_size AS "fileSize" FROM notice_files nf JOIN notice n ON n.notice_id = nf.notice_id WHERE nf.notice_file_id = #{notice_file_id} AND n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notice n SET view_count = NVL(n.view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_type, n.title FROM notice n AND n.notice_id > #{notice_id}
ORDER BY n.notice_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_type, n.title FROM notice n AND n.notice_id < #{notice_id}
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

choose.when: INSERT INTO notice ( notice_id, notice_type, workspace_id, project_id, task_id, member_id, title, content, status, view_count, created ) SELECT #{notice_id}, '0', wd.workspace_id, NULL, NULL, #{requester_member_id}, #{title}, #{content}, NVL(#{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1), 0, SYSDATE FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members actor ON actor.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.workspace_id = #{workspace_id} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND actor.member_id = #{requester_member_id} AND actor.status = 0 AND actor.role >= 70

INSERT INTO notice ( notice_id, notice_type, workspace_id, project_id, task_id, member_id, title, content, status, view_count, created ) SELECT #{notice_id}, '1', p.workspace_id, p.project_id, NULL, #{requester_member_id}, #{title}, #{content}, NVL(#{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1), 0, SYSDATE FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id JOIN workspace_members actor ON actor.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE p.project_id = #{project_id} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND actor.member_id = #{requester_member_id} AND actor.status = 0 AND ( actor.role >= 70 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.status = 0 AND own.role >= 50 ) )
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO notice ( notice_id, notice_type, workspace_id, project_id, task_id, member_id, title, content, status, view_count, created ) SELECT #{notice_id}, #{notice_type}, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{requester_member_id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0, SYSDATE FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_files ( notice_file_id, notice_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded ) SELECT seq_notice_files.NEXTVAL, n.notice_id, #{original_name}, #{stored_name}, #{file_path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{file_size, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE FROM notice n WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notice n SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = NVL(#{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, status), updated = SYSDATE WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL
UPDATE notice n SET status = 0, updated = SYSDATE WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(n.status, 1) <> 0
